name: Mightier Than The Sword
body:
Through understanding the world, you understand the movements and motives behind combat.

Prerequisite(s): Artist’s inspiration class feature.

Benefit(s): You may spend 1 round of inspiration to improve your effective BAB while you maintain this technique. Your BAB improves by +1 for every 3 levels of wandering artist you possess, to a maximum of +6 at 18th level, for as long as you maintain this technique.

Special: This enhanced BAB grants you extra attacks. It cannot be used to qualify for feats.

The Wandering Artist 2014, Little Red Goblin Games LLC, Authors: Andrew Howe, Caleb Aylsworth, Scott Gladstein, Dayton Johnson, Caleb Aylsworth, Jeremiah Zerby
